Bad Zurzach Rehabilitation Clinic offers rehabilitation in all facets at a high medical level. The rehabilitation offer ranges from neurology to musculoskeletal/rheumatology, cardiology to sleep medicine (Clinic for Sleep Medicine). The Pain Center Bad Zurzach offers pain treatments within special programs that include pain diagnosis, counseling, and therapy. We offer a varied field of activity, a modern working environment, and attractive working hours (Mon - Fri from 07:00 - 16:30 - no weekend services). Your tasks
• Blood sampling: You will take daily blood samples on the wards and in the laboratory
• Lab: You are responsible for the analysis of blood/urine (hematology, chemistry, urine sediment and UK) including internal/external quality controls
• Cooperation: You will work with an external lab
• ECG: You will take resting and 7-day ECG's
• Planning: You will plan blood sampling and ECG's
• Organization: You will handle performance billing in the LIS (Laboratory Information System) and purchasing, as well as other office work
• Radiology: You will perform conventional and high-dose X-ray examinations (extremities, thorax, spine, pelvis, hips, etc.)
• Report management: You will send X-ray prescriptions to external institutions and import reports into the KIS Your profile
• Education: Completed training as a Medical Practice Assistant (MPA), mandatory with radiology diploma, possibly diploma for high-dose radiology already present or willingness to obtain it
• Experience: Good experience in blood sampling, general lab work, and ECG placement
• Personality: You bring responsibility, process-oriented thinking, and an empathetic attitude, as well as teamwork, resilience, high flexibility in working days, and good communication skills
• IT skills: Proficient in MS Office and common clinical systems
• Languages: Good German language skills What we offer

Chez nous, non seulement tu soutiens nos patients dans leur parcours de réhabilitation, mais tu accompagnes également les apprenants et étudiants de manière compétente, valorisante et avec un savoir-faire pédagogique à travers leur formation. Tu favorises les compétences professionnelles, méthodologiques et sociales et tu contribues activement à une formation pratique de haute qualité. Le soin, la responsabilité, le plaisir d'encadrer et un grand cœur pour les personnes sont des prérequis importants pour promouvoir au mieux nos apprenants et étudiants et prendre soin de nos patients. Coopération interdisciplinaire : Tu travailles de manière autonome au sein d'une équipe interdisciplinaire etmaintiens une coopération étroite avec les formateurs, les infirmiers, les responsables de soins infirmiers, les thérapeutes et les médecins. Soins infirmiers : Tu restes actif dans les soins infirmiers (environ 20 %) et assures des soins infirmiers de réhabilitation activants et orientés vers les objectifs et les besoins. Diversité : Tu assumes des tâches variées et responsables, tu assumes la responsabilité de la formation des professions de soins infirmiers, y compris l'assurance qualité, et tu es directement impliqué dans les soins de nos patients. Ton profil

• Formation continue : Tu es en possession du cours de formation professionnelle SVEB 1.
• Expérience : Tu as au moins un an d'expérience dans le domaine des soins infirmiers et idéalement de l'expérience en tant que personne d'accompagnement journalier. Personnalité : Tu es une personnalité communicative avec une forte orientation client, une compétence sociale et un esprit d'équipe. La flexibilité, l'indépendance et une apparence compétente et soignée te caractérisent. De plus, tu prends plaisir à former et à accompagner les jeunes et les jeunes adultes. Ce que nous offrons

• Atmosphère de travail inspirante et collaborative : Travailler dans une équipe de soutien et valorisante qui s'engage ensemble pour les meilleurs soins possibles aux patients.

• Contributions sociales supérieures à la moyenne : Bénéficie de contributions sociales attractives et d'avantages complets.

descriptionByLocale.it: La Fondazione Promozione della Salute Bad Zurzach + Baden sta pianificando di automatizzare ulteriormente i processi di approvvigionamento a livello di gruppo. descriptionByLocale.en: The Health Promotion Foundation Bad Zurzach + Baden is planning to further automate the group-wide procurement processes. descriptionByLocale.it:
Ci prendiamo cura delle nostre 24 pazienti e pazienti in una stazione neurologica. Lavorerai in un team di 20 membri dello staff.
• Offriamo un ambiente di lavoro rispettoso con strutture chiare e comprensibili, nonché un team collaborativo e familiare. Se stai cercando un posto di lavoro in cui il lavoro di squadra e il rispetto reciproco sono al centro, sei nel posto giusto. Ogni opinione viene ascoltata e ogni persona è un componente importante del nostro team.
• Le tue mansioni: - Assistenza orientata al paziente: aiuterai le nostre pazienti e pazienti a trovare il modo di tornare a una vita indipendente. Il tuo lavoro avrà un impatto diretto sul processo di guarigione e trattamento. - Compiti diversi: assumerai la responsabilità totale dell'assistenza e della cura individuale durante la notte. - Formazione continua: ti offriremo formazione esterna regolare per mantenere le tue conoscenze specialistiche sempre aggiornate. Il tuo profilo: - Formazione: laurea in infermieristica o riconoscimento equivalente con almeno un SRK-PreCheck positivo. - Esperienza: hai esperienza nel gestire situazioni di assistenza complessa e nella tecnologia medica. - Impegno: sei impegnato nella collaborazione interdisciplinare. - Personalità: sei una persona comunicativa con una forte orientazione al cliente, competenza sociale e orientamento al team. Inoltre, dimostri flessibilità, autonomia e un aspetto competente e curato.
• Cosa offriamo: - Partecipazione: lavora in un ambiente di lavoro moderno e contribuisci attivamente. - Clima di lavoro ispiratore e collaborativo: lavora in un team di supporto e rispettoso che si impegna per l'assistenza dei pazienti. - Bonus di flessibilità: partecipazione volontaria al nostro interno pool di infermieri per turni aggiuntivi, che vengono retribuiti in modo attraente. - Prestazioni sociali superiori alla media: approfitta di prestazioni sociali attraenti e benefit. - Formazione e aggiornamento: partecipazione alle spese per la formazione e l'aggiornamento. - Sconti: utilizza sconti presso diversi partner, come grossisti, farmacie e la nostra membership presso Benefit@work. - Ingresso gratuito: goditi l'ingresso gratuito e altri vantaggi nella wellness-therme FORTYSEVEN. Ci piacerebbe ricevere la tua domanda online. Contatto: Franziska Hintermann Direttore del servizio infermieristico Telefono: +41 56 269 53 07 E-mail: franziska.hintermann@zurzachcare.ch
descriptionByLocale.en:
We care for our 24 patients in a neurological station. You will work in a team of 20 staff members.
• We offer a respectful work environment with clear and manageable structures, as well as a collaborative and family-like team. If you are looking for a workplace where teamwork and mutual respect are central, you are in the right place. Every opinion is heard and every person is an important part of our team.
• Your tasks: - Patient-oriented care: You will help our patients find their way back to an independent life. Your work will have a direct impact on the healing and treatment process. - Diverse tasks: You will take on the overall responsibility for individual care and support during the night. - Continuous training: We will offer you regular external training to keep your specialist knowledge up-to-date.
• Your profile: - Education: Completed training as a nurse or equivalent recognition with at least one positive SRK-PreCheck. - Experience: You have experience in handling complex care situations and medical technology. - Commitment: You are committed to interdisciplinary cooperation. - Personality: You are a communicative personality with a high customer orientation, social competence and team orientation. Furthermore, you demonstrate flexibility, independence and a competent and well-groomed appearance.
• What we offer: - Participation: Work in a modern working environment and actively contribute. - Inspiring and collaborative work climate: Work in a supportive and respectful team that is committed to the best possible patient care. - Flexibility bonus: Voluntary participation in our internal nursing pool for additional shifts, which are additionally remunerated. - Above-average social security benefits: Benefit from attractive social security benefits and comprehensive benefits. - Training and further education: Generous co-financing of training and further education. - Discounts: Use discounts at various partners, such as wholesalers, pharmacies and our membership at Benefit@work. - Free entry: Enjoy free entry and other discounts in the wellness-therme FORTYSEVEN. We look forward to your online application. Contact: Franziska Hintermann Head of Nursing Service Phone: +41 56 269 53 07 E-mail: franziska.hintermann@zurzachcare.ch

descriptionByLocale.it:
La nostra clinica di medicina del sonno (KSM) a Lucerna è un'istituzione specializzata per la cura interdisciplinare dei pazienti con disturbi del sonno. Il nostro obiettivo: un aiuto duraturo per un sonno riposante e un miglioramento della qualità della vita. Con un'ampia gamma di trattamenti e il nostro team multiprofessionale offriamo la medicina basata sulle evidenze a livello elevato e la cura dei nostri pazienti in modo ambulatoriale e online. I nostri clienti sono persone con disturbi del sonno di tutti i tipi. Un'immagine comune di malattia è l'insonnia, spesso accompagnata da disturbi psicologici concomitanti (ad esempio depressione, disturbi d'ansia, ADHD, disturbi somatici o abuso di sostanze).
• Le tue mansioni: - Supporto: supporterai e parteciperai alle attività di diagnosi e trattamento dei disturbi del sonno. Dopo la fase di inserimento, potrai anche gestire i tuoi campi di attività sotto supervisione e documentarli. - Valutazioni: preparerai gli strumenti diagnostici (diagnostica del sonno, questionari psicometrici) e aiuterai nella loro valutazione. - Hospitazioni: avrai l'opportunità di partecipare alle prime e alle sessioni di chiarimento, nonché nella terapia successiva. - Scambi: parteciperai alle riunioni di specialisti, alle relazioni giornaliere con presentazione di casi su diversi argomenti di medicina del sonno e psicoterapia. - Conversazioni: le prime o le conversazioni di anamnesi possono essere condotte e documentate durante il periodo di stage, sotto la supervisione appropriata. Alcune attività terapeutiche come l'istruzione sui metodi di rilassamento saranno gestite in modo autonomo. - Medicina del sonno: supporterai il team interdisciplinare nella raccolta dell'anamnesi e nella preparazione e nel follow-up delle consultazioni. Il tuo profilo: - Formazione: partecipazione a un corso di laurea magistrale in psicologia, ma può anche svolgersi alla fine del corso di laurea. - Personalità: interessi per l'argomento del sonno e apertura verso le questioni mediche, lavoro di squadra, flessibilità. - Conoscenze: buone conoscenze informatiche e molto buone conoscenze della lingua tedesca a parole e in scrittura, conoscenze di lingue straniere sono un vantaggio. Our Sleep Medicine Clinic (KSM) in Lucerne is a specialized facility for the interdisciplinary care of patients with sleep disorders. Our goal: sustainable help for restful sleep and improved quality of life. With a broad range of treatments and our multiprofessional team, we offer evidence-based medicine at the highest level and care for our patients ambulatory and online. Our clients are people with sleep disorders of all kinds. A common disease picture is insomnia, which is often accompanied by comorbid mental disorders (e.g. depression, anxiety disorders, ADHD, somatoform disorders or substance abuse).
• Your tasks: - Support: You will support and participate in the areas of diagnostics and treatment of sleep disorders. After the onboarding phase, you can also take on your own fields of activity under supervision and document them. - Evaluations: You will prepare the diagnostic instruments (sleep diagnostics, psychometric questionnaires) and help with their evaluation. - Observations: You will have the opportunity to observe first and clarification conversations as well as in the subsequent therapy. - Exchange: You will participate in specialist meetings, daily reports with case presentations on various sleep medical and psychotherapeutic topics. - Conversations: First or anamnesis conversations can also be conducted and documented during the internship, under appropriate supervision. Certain therapeutic tasks such as the instruction of relaxation techniques will be carried out independently. - Sleep medicine: You will support the interdisciplinary team in collecting the anamnesis and in the preparation and follow-up of consultations.
• Your profile: - Education: Participation in a master's degree program in psychology, but can also take place towards the end of the bachelor's degree. - Personality: Interest in the topic of sleep as well as openness to medical questions, teamwork, flexibility. - Knowledge: Good IT knowledge and very good knowledge of the German language in word and writing, knowledge of foreign languages is an advantage. Your benefits: - Flexible working days: You can choose your working days with us - the care is guaranteed by psychologists and psychologists with a university degree. - Active participation: Work in a modern working environment and actively participate. - Inspiring and collaborative working atmosphere: Work in a supportive, respectful and humorous team that works together for the best possible patient care. - Above-average social security benefits: Benefit from attractive social security benefits and comprehensive benefits. - Discounts: Use discounts at various partners, such as wholesalers, car dealerships, pharmacies, as well as our membership in Benefit@work. - Free entry: Enjoy free entry and other discounts in the wellness-therme FORTYSEVEN. Contact: Selina L. Combertaldi M.Sc. Psychologist Phone: 041 202 06 60 We look forward to your online application directly via our online tool!

Notre clinique de médecine du sommeil (KSM) à Lucerne est un établissement spécialisé dans les soins interdisciplinaires des patients souffrant de troubles du sommeil. Notre objectif : aider durablement à un sommeil réparateur et à améliorer la qualité de vie. Avec une large gamme de traitements et notre équipe multiprofessionnelle, nous offrons une médecine basée sur des preuves au plus haut niveau et nous prenons en charge nos patients en ambulatoire et en ligne. Nos clients sont des personnes souffrant de troubles du sommeil de tous types. Un tableau de maladie fréquent est l'insomnie, qui est souvent accompagnée de troubles mentaux comorbides (par exemple, dépression, troubles anxieux, TDAH, troubles somatoformes ou abuse de substances).
• Vos tâches: - Soutien : Vous soutiendrez et participerez aux domaines de diagnostic et de traitement des troubles du sommeil. Après la phase d'intégration, vous pourrez également prendre en charge vos propres domaines d'activité sous supervision et les documenter. - Évaluations : Vous préparerez les instruments diagnostiques (diagnostic du sommeil, questionnaires psychométriques) et aiderez à leur évaluation. - Observations : Vous aurez l'opportunité d'observer les premières conversations et de clarification ainsi que dans la thérapie suivante. - Échanges : Vous participerez à des réunions de spécialistes, des rapports quotidiens avec des présentations de cas sur divers thèmes de médecine du sommeil et de psychothérapie. - Conversations : Les premières ou les conversations d'anamnèse peuvent également être menées et documentées pendant le stage, sous la supervision appropriée. Certaines tâches thérapeutiques telles que l'instruction des techniques de relaxation seront réalisées de manière autonome. - Médecine du sommeil : Vous soutiendrez l'équipe interdisciplinaire dans la collecte de l'anamnèse et dans la préparation et le suivi des consultations.
• Votre profil: - Formation : Participation à un programme de maîtrise en psychologie, mais peut également avoir lieu vers la fin des études de premier cycle. - Personnalité : Intérêt pour le sujet du sommeil ainsi qu'une ouverture aux questions médicales, travail d'équipe, flexibilité. - Connaissances : Bonne connaissance de l'informatique et très bonne connaissance de la langue allemande à l'oral et à l'écrit, connaissance des langues étrangères est un atout. Vos avantages: - Jours de travail flexibles : Vous pouvez choisir vos jours de travail chez nous - les soins sont garantis par des psychologues et des psychologues ayant un diplôme universitaire. - Participation active : Travaillez dans un environnement de travail moderne et participez activement. - Atmosphère de travail inspirante et collaborative : Travaillez dans une équipe de soutien, respectueuse et humoristique qui travaille ensemble pour les meilleurs soins possibles aux patients. - Prestations sociales supérieures à la moyenne : Bénéficiez de prestations sociales attractives et de nombreux avantages. - Réductions : Utilisez des réductions chez divers partenaires, tels que les grossistes, les concessionnaires automobiles, les pharmacies, ainsi que notre appartenance à Benefit@work. - Entrée gratuite : Profitez de l'entrée gratuite et d'autres réductions dans la wellness-therme FORTYSEVEN.
